title: leucanthemum ceratophylloides subsp. tenuifolium
intro: Leucanthemum ceratophylloides subsp. tenuifolium, commonly known as the White Hawkweed, is a species of flowering plant in the daisy family. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health issues, and its health benefits include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Leucanthemum ceratophylloides subsp. tenuifolium include pain relief, wound healing, and antiseptic effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. However, more research is needed to fully understand the plant's medicinal properties and potential applications.
